iQIYI Holiday Snapshot Shows Increased Viewing Time, Big Screen Dominance

A snapshot of iQIYI's 2026 National Day Holiday viewing habits indicates a rise in daily viewing time by over 12%, driven by premium titles. Big screens accounted for nearly 60% of this viewing time.
